title: ProtectedRoute
summary: The protected route a discovery request would reveal.

sections.title: Fields
sections.body: path is the route pattern; id is present for nested file routes. Authorize by role or permission, not by exact URL, since the same pattern serves every matching path.
sections.code:
const authorize: RouteAuthorizer = (request, route: ProtectedRoute) =>
  route.path.startsWith("/admin") && isAdmin(request);
